name: Higher Logic
description: Higher Logic Thrive Community is a hosted platform for member communities, discussions, events, knowledge sharing, engagement, and association collaboration.
agentUseSummary: Connect one dedicated contact-specific IAM key and API password to the fixed US or Canada Thrive Community API. Agents can inspect the exact connected contact and bounded, privacy-reduced Community, Discussion, and Event catalog metadata through six fixed read-only endpoints. Content, communication, membership changes, administration, moderation, bulk access, private identity, login flows, and arbitrary APIs remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: HIGHER_LOGIC_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Higher Logic API region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter us for api.higherlogic.com or ca for api.onlinecommunity.ca. Relay accepts no custom API host.

credentialRequirements.name: HIGHER_LOGIC_CONTACT_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Higher Logic contact key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact ContactKey represented by the dedicated IAM credential. Relay rejects a different authenticated contact.

credentialRequirements.name: HIGHER_LOGIC_IAM_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Higher Logic IAM key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Obtain a dedicated contact-specific IAM key from Higher Logic. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the HLIAMKey header.

credentialRequirements.name: HIGHER_LOGIC_API_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Higher Logic API password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the pre-established password for the dedicated IAM credential. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the HLPassword header.

capabilities.label: Read community catalog
capabilities.description: Inspect the connected contact and bounded joined, viewable, and contributable Community metadata.

capabilities.label: Read discussion catalog
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded eligible Discussion identity and subscription metadata without content.

capabilities.label: Read event catalog
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded upcoming Event schedule and type metadata without descriptions or registrants.

allowed.label: Read connected contact
allowed.description: Read reduced identity and status metadata for the exactly configured Higher Logic contact.

allowed.label: List joined communities
allowed.description: List up to twenty-five reduced Communities joined by the connected contact.

allowed.label: List viewable communities
allowed.description: List up to twenty-five reduced non-hidden Communities visible to the connected contact.

allowed.label: List contributable communities
allowed.description: List up to twenty-five reduced Communities where the connected contact can contribute.

approvalRequired.label: List eligible discussions
approvalRequired.description: List up to twenty-five reduced Discussion identity and subscription summaries without posts, bodies, authors, or URLs.

approvalRequired.label: List upcoming events
approvalRequired.description: List up to twenty-five reduced upcoming Event schedule and type summaries without descriptions, registrants, contact data, registration links, or raw records.

blocked.label: Read or write content
blocked.description: Discussion posts, questions, answers, blogs, comments, documents, attachments, library content, announcements, ideas, descriptions, message bodies, files, media, and arbitrary rich content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage contacts
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, merging, impersonating, searching, exporting, changing demographics, profiles, pictures, email preferences, security groups, terms acceptance, or code-of-conduct acceptance is outside V1.

blocked.label: Change community membership
blocked.description: Joining, leaving, inviting, accepting or rejecting invitations, subscriptions, follows, favorites, RSVPs, volunteering, friendships, and all other membership or relationship changes are outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer Thrive Community
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, restoring, or configuring Communities, Discussions, Events, Libraries, Tags, Ideation, Automation Rules, External Activities, search items, settings, integrations, and site state is outside V1.

blocked.label: Moderate community
blocked.description: Editing, recommending, deleting, removing, approving, marking answers, changing idea status, and otherwise moderating content or contacts is outside V1.

blocked.label: Communicate or notify
blocked.description: Posting, replying, private messaging, marking messages, email, invitations, announcements, notifications, cross-posting, anonymous posting, and outbound integrations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run bulk or analytics actions
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, bulk loops, polling, reports, tracking metrics, data feeds, exports, imports, registrant data, attendance, member updates, analytics, and sustained high-rate access are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read broader identity data
blocked.description: Emails, phone numbers, addresses, demographics, profile fields, company data, security groups, friends, inbox data, invitations, registrants, volunteers, external activities, and raw Contact records are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Higher Logic APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, parameters, bodies, headers, alternate hosts, raw responses, API discovery, login or token endpoints, OIDC flows, browser cookies, Thrive Marketing APIs, SOAP, Push API, File API, CLI, and direct database access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Connected-contact and joined, viewable, and contributable Community catalog reads run directly. Eligible Discussion and upcoming Event metadata require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All six selected bounded Higher Logic V1 reads run without Relay per-action approval; encrypted credentials, fixed region, exact-contact binding, provider permissions, fixed routes, bounds, audits, privacy reduction, and system blocks still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts six fixed read-only Higher Logic API v2 wrappers and keeps the customer-owned IAM key and API password encrypted outside agent context.

providerSetup.blocker: No representative Higher Logic Thrive Community tenant, dedicated contact-specific IAM credentials, or staging Community, Discussion, and Event fixtures were available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Higher Logic Thrive Community customer obtains dedicated contact-specific IAM credentials, records the exact ContactKey and US or Canada region, and enters all four values in Relay. Staging acceptance verifies region selection, exact contact binding, reduced projections, Safe approval binding, Dangerous execution, provider permission and rate errors, credential rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Higher Logic's official API v2 reference documents the exact GetWhoAmI, Community catalog, eligible Discussion, and bounded upcoming Event endpoints wrapped by Relay.
Higher Logic's official API portal identifies API v2.0 as the current Thrive Community API and links both OIDC and legacy authentication documentation.

Higher Logic's official OIDC documentation describes a separate tenant-specific authorization-code flow and warns not to combine OIDC with legacy HLIAMKey and HLPassword credentials; Relay V1 exposes no login or OIDC flow.
Higher Logic identifies the API as a Thrive Community API, documents the Canada api.onlinecommunity.ca host, and advises a three-to-four requests-per-second usage rate.
Higher Logic documents customer-issued IAM key and password credentials, warns they can access community data, and instructs customers to keep them private.
Higher Logic publishes its current legal and privacy materials from the official provider domain.
